name: primitives-effects-click
title: Click
blurb: Click effects animate on interaction with ripple, ring, burst, or particle…
description: Renders animated effects on click within child elements. Supports multiple effect variants (ripple, ring, crosshair, burst, particles) with customizable color, size, and duration.
use_when: Buttons or interactive elements where visual feedback on click enhances perceived interactivity and response.
avoid_when: Contexts where animation might distract from critical interactions.
a11y: Click effects are visual feedback only; focus and keyboard interaction work normally on child content.
